narrative: On the almanack. The almanac open at the day. A full moon is already printed in the column. A small tick beside it, and no cross, and no name. On the almanack. The rest of the day's line is blank. The pen is set down. On the almanack. The almanac closed. The three sheets are still on the board in the same candle.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Marked the moon and left the rest of the line empty.

entities.name: the almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in The full moon
